notes: Authoritative source: Symetrix official Radius NX 12x8 Data Sheet (hosted copy via sisme.com, matches manufacturer symetrix.co content). Rear-panel layout per datasheet: IEC power inlet; ARC port (RJ45, power+RS-485 to ARC wall panels); A/B Ethernet ports (1000Base-T RJ45, Composer/control/third-party IP control, auto-crossover); C/D Dante ports (1000Base-T RJ45, redundant primary/secondary, 64x64/128ch Dante audio); USB Host (unused/reserved per rear panel silkscreen, not detailed in text - omitted); USB Audio (Type B, USB 2.0, class 1.0 legacy); RS-232 (3-pin serial, Tx/Rx/GND, wired straight-through - connector form not explicitly stated as DB9 or terminal block in datasheet text, rear-panel diagram shows it in the small connector cluster with USB; modeled as rs232 connector id, physical form likely a captive/mini connector - treat as medium-confidence on exact physical connector shape though electrical spec is confirmed); Factory Reset switch (not a signal port, omitted); Logic Outputs (8, terminal block, common-ground pins, 5V pulled-high/0V active, drives LEDs directly, not a standard signal connector in the provided enum so modeled as euroblock); External Control Inputs (4, terminal block, 0-3.3VDC, used as 4 potentiometer or 8 switch inputs, modeled as euroblock); Analog Line Outputs (8, balanced, 3.81mm terminal block/euroblock, +4dBu nominal, +24dBu max); Expansion Card Slot (accepts optional I/O cards - VoIP, analog telephone, digital I/O, mic/line, AEC, analog output, or 8x8 USB card - not a fixed physical connector itself, omitted as port); Analog Mic/Line Inputs (12, balanced, 3.81mm terminal block/euroblock, switchable mic/line, +48VDC phantom power per input). Unit is 1U rack-mountable, 100-240VAC universal power via detachable IEC cord. No SDI/HDMI/video I/O - this is an audio DSP only. Logic I/O and control-input ports have no listed connector-family match beyond euroblock in the allowed enum; used euroblock as closest fit since these are captive screw/pluggable terminal blocks matching the analog audio I/O style shown in the rear panel photo.

ports.name: RS-232
ports.note: 3-pin (Tx/Rx/GND) serial for third-party accessory control, 57.6 kbaud default; exact physical connector shell not explicitly specified in data sheet

ports.name: Logic Outputs
ports.note: 8 logic outputs + 4 paired common-ground pins, 0V active / 5V inactive, drives LEDs directly

ports.name: External Control Inputs
ports.note: 4 analog control inputs (0-3.3VDC), usable as 4 potentiometer or 8 switch inputs

ports.name: Analog Mic/Line Inputs
ports.note: 12 balanced switchable mic/line inputs, 3.81mm terminal blocks, +48VDC phantom power per input
